punchline: A vivid memory is not an accurate memory.
thirty_sec: In 1961 Betty and Barney Hill got home two hours late, and Betty drew a star map under hypnosis two years later. Fish fitted it to Zeta Reticuli; Sagan and Soter said the match was weak.
question: Which of your decisions rests on a vivid memory you never checked against a record?
key_contrast: The memory was vivid; the check was missing.
